sql:
SELECT
  MAX(subq_11.new_member_count) AS new_member_count
  , MAX(subq_18.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_18.first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_18.first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , MAX(subq_18.repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(1) AS new_member_count
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', registered_at) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-15'
) subq_11
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN member_id END) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_sales_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_sequence" order_sequence_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-15'
) subq_18
answer: 统计范围为青禾当前客户数据内 2026-06-01 至 2026-06-15（含首尾），未按门店或地区分组。结果：注册会员数 2 个账户；观测期首购会员数 0 个账户；观测期首单净销售额 0 分，即 0.00 元；观测期首单数 0 单；观测期后续购买订单数 0 单。首购、首单及首单销售额均按全覆盖历史先确定每个账户首笔有效订单，再筛选落入该窗口的订单；后续购买订单指第二笔及以后有效订单落入窗口的订单数，不等同于复购人数。上述 0 均为该统计口径和覆盖范围内的零，不是未定义。本次结果基于合成测试数据，覆盖期为 2024-09-01 至 2026-09-01。
